ANKAMA.TITLE: Backend Mission - Twitch / Ankama
ANKAMA.DESC: Development of the 'Feed the Beast' Twitch extension managing massive traffic spikes.
ANKAMA.LONG_DESC: CONTEXT: Create a massive interactive experience for Twitch viewers with the Feed the Beast extension during the launch of a major update for the game DOFUS. SOLUTION: Development of a high-performance micro-services architecture based on Node.js, Redis, MongoDB, and Cloudflare, orchestrated via PM2 Cluster Mode. RESULT: Record-breaking management capacity with over 130m interactions and 250,000 simultaneous viewers without any service interruption.

LINKPART.TITLE: Fullstack Developer (Apprenticeship)
LINKPART.DESC: Evolution of a complex SaaS platform (Hub3e). Transition to hybrid micro-services and event-driven architectures.
LINKPART.LONG_DESC: CONTEXT: Evolving Hub3e, France's #1 apprenticeship platform connecting candidates, companies, and over 200 training centers. SOLUTION: Design of event-driven architectures using AWS Lambda and Node.js to automate data flows and optimize mass record management. RESULT: Real-time system synchronization and successful lead on the technical migration of clients to a new major version of the application.
